name: image-puma
description: Plan and run local batch image preparation from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Image Puma runs locally over stdio. It plans batch compression, resize, crop, naming, and metadata-cleaning work before writing files, and requires explicit confirmation before running a stored plan.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed Image Folders
allowed_directories.description: Folders Image Puma may read images from and write planned outputs into.

tools.name: image_puma_plan
tools.description: Plan a local Image Puma batch. For Magick-style jobs pass quality, format, and lossless — skip list_presets and settings_schema. Supports Windows paths and file:// URLs.

tools.name: image_puma_run
tools.description: Run a previously created Image Puma plan after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: image_puma_list_presets
tools.description: List named pipelines such as web-upload or thumbnail. Skip for Magick-style quality jobs.

tools.name: image_puma_describe_preset
tools.description: Return exact settings for one named preset. Skip unless the user asked for that preset.

tools.name: image_puma_settings_schema
tools.description: JSON Schema for nested customSettings. Skip unless you need crop, resize, or naming beyond quality/format/lossless.

tools.name: image_puma_generate_favicon
tools.description: Generate browser favicon assets plus ICO, ICNS, and PNG app icons from one local image.

prompts.name: image-puma
prompts.description: Plan and run a local batch image job: compress, resize, convert, strip metadata, thumbnails, favicons.
prompts.text: Use the Image Puma MCP tools for this local image task: ${arguments.task}. Create an Image Puma plan only first — call image_puma_plan. Do not run it yet. For Magick-style jobs pass quality, optional format, and optional lossless on image_puma_plan; do not call list_presets or settings_schema first. Call list_presets only for a named pipeline like web-upload. Show the returned plan, warnings, and planned output paths. Call image_puma_run only after my explicit confirmation.
